text: When the fourfold set of intellect, ego, and mind, each in relation to a single sense organ, is present, the fourfold set arises. Upon the perception of the fourfold set and the determination of the object, the simultaneous activity of intellect, ego, mind, and the eyes occurs; at one and the same time, they perceive form, saying, “This is a pillar.” Similarly, intellect, ego, mind, and the tongue simultaneously grasp taste.
